label: arm_wording_mechanism
rule: Arm-wording mechanism forecast, written from token counts and the main collection's scored discovery draws before any arm-wording output is scored. w(m, d, t): share of model m's requested-direct outputs in the arm-wording screen under direct clause d on task t longer than 16 generated tokens (n_output_tokens > 16; 100 outputs per cell: 2 configurations x 50 screening items). Predicted gain over the requested arm under clause d: pooled (1 - w) x g_F, short-stratum (1 - w) x g_S, partial (1 - rho x w) x g_F; g_F the main collection's chain-of-thought minus forced-direct accuracy (strict, mean over its discovery draws), g_S the same on rows whose requested output had at most 16 tokens (an empty stratum counts 0), rho the task's median within-model recovery on long answers (discovery draws, strict, models with at least a tenth of their requested answers long). Reversal shares: strict (pairs tied within estimators.TIE_TOL on either side are not reversed), as src/arm_wording.reversal. Statements S1-S5 of src/arm_wording_mechanism.py with TOL = 0.05 and W_RANGE = 0.2; observed quantities on the arm-wording run's six configurations, strict scores, every trigger.

statements.S1_clause_reversal: per task, the observed clause-only reversal share of the requested arm lies within 0.05 of the predicted range
statements.S2_clause_vs_template: per task, the clause-only reversal share exceeds the configuration-only reversal share of the requested arm
statements.S3_arm_switch: per task and clause, the observed arm-switch share lies within 0.05 of the predicted range
statements.S4_requested_rises: per task, among models whose screen w ranges over at least 0.2: (a) the pooled within-model slope of requested accuracy on w is positive; (b) more than half of those models have a positive slope
statements.S5_forced_steadier: per task: (a) the median over models of the across-clause SD of forced accuracy is smaller than that of requested accuracy; (b) forced varies less than requested in more than half of the models

gsm8k.rho_from: median within-model recovery on long answers (R_L - F_L) / (C_L - F_L), discovery draws, strict, models with w >= 0.1 and a positive denominator

math.rho_from: median within-model recovery on long answers (R_L - F_L) / (C_L - F_L), discovery draws, strict, models with w >= 0.1 and a positive denominator

clause_texts.dir0: Give only the final answer, without any working.
clause_texts.dir1: Provide the solution, omitting any calculations or explanations.
clause_texts.dir2: State the answer only, excluding all intermediary steps.
clause_texts.dir3: The final result is all that is required, do not include any reasoning.

note: read the arm-wording screen's token counts (no correctness) and the main collection's scored discovery draws; written before any arm-wording output was scored.
